title: Preserve the accepted contract of the inlined capability callee
subject: include/game/resource_font.h:175; func_0016b6a4
summary: The new declaration and func_0016b6a4 treat func_001f18c0 as bool(U8Directory *), but its already accepted C++ definition is bool(const FileInputStream *). These are unrelated canonical object contracts, not interchangeable declarations of the same C-linkage function. Preincluding resource_font.h with that accepted definition fails ARMCC with error #338. The constant-return linker rewrite erases the call and therefore hides, rather than validates, this discrepancy; use one evidence-backed canonical contract instead of assigning an incompatible directory identity solely to obtain MATCH.

title: Keep the SDK applet commands byte-wide parameter contract
subject: include/game/applet.h:43; func_001923d4
summary: The new prototype declares func_0012ff20 as unsigned(unsigned, unsigned), while the accepted SDK C++ definition is CtrResult(unsigned int, unsigned char), with CtrResult typedefd to int. The new func_001923d4 caller consequently uses a different return signedness and widens the byte-wide input at the same C-linkage boundary. Including the new canonical header with the accepted definition fails ARMCC error #338. Restore one shared SDK contract, including its actual input width, and reconcile the wrapper signature instead of retaining two incompatible declarations hidden by the unchecked-C++ waiver.

title: Use the canonical input owner and preserve the forwarded status width
subject: src/wave14/func_001462d4.c:5; include/game/display_animation.h:119
summary: The original natural caller func_001821f4 forwards bss_004b97ac, canonically an InputSessionContext, and its unmodified machine-word status to this wrapper; the accepted func_0013e9d8 supplies that status from signed-byte configuration. AudioVolumeState * rejects this canonical caller with ARMCC #167, and the unsigned-short formal adds a truncation absent from the original forwarding path. An independently written caller using the canonical input owner plus int status matches the original entire 16-byte function (exit 0); fixing only the owner while retaining unsigned short instead produces 20 bytes and a mismatch (exit 1). The wrapper itself matches because it ignores its first input and forwards its second without checking the incoming ABI; correct both the shared declaration and definition now rather than waiting for the uncredited caller to expose the contract.

title: Unify the shutdown input with the canonical audio task manager
subject: src/wave13/func_001838ec.c:6; include/game/audio_voice.h:427
summary: The existing getter func_00185de4 returns AudioTaskManager *, and the original natural caller func_00185d74 calls that getter immediately followed by func_001838ec with the same unadjusted pointer. Introducing unrelated AudioWorker * makes this existing cross-unit contract incompatible: a natural bridge using only the two canonical headers fails ARMCC #167. Matching the flag at +0x28 and queue at +0x38 explains why the isolated body matches but does not make the distinct C struct pointer types compatible. Use the existing manager identity consistently, or explicitly reconcile the canonical shared representation, rather than requiring a cast solely to repair this newly split owner type.
